notes: Dzongdags are appointed by His Majesty the King and are not published in one official machine-readable list, so each name here was read from that dzongkhag's own website or a dated appointment notice.

Every entry shows how well it is confirmed and when the page was checked. “Confirmed” means a dated appointment or welcome notice; “from the dzongkhag website” means a signed page that carries no date, so it could be out of date; “unconfirmed” means the sources disagree or look incomplete.
If you know an entry is wrong, please report it — the link to do so is below each list.
